business_definition: Standardized 4-digit General Ledger natural account code (4000-8000)
Official accounting ledger line title
Income statement classification (Revenue, COGS, OPEX, Non-Operating, Tax)
Management reporting P&L roll-up group (Operating Revenue, Personnel & Benefits, etc.)
Accounting debit/credit convention (Debit or Credit)
Indicates whether account is included above EBITDA (Yes/No)
Accounting policy definition for the natural account
Unique organizational department/cost center identifier (CC-100 to CC-700)
Department or business unit name
Consolidation subsidiary code (UK_HQ, EU_SUB, US_SUB)
Country of legal registration
Operating geography (EMEA, Americas, Global)
Executive reporting pillar (Commercial, R&D / Product, Operations, Growth, Corporate G&A)
Executive accountable for P&L variance and spend approval
Unique supplier master record ID (VND-001 to VND-012)
Legal supplier or counterparty name
Procurement spend category (Infrastructure & Cloud, Audit & Advisory, Facilities, etc.)
Vendor billing domicile country
Contractual net payment terms (Due on Receipt, Net 15, Net 30, Net 45)
Procurement vendor classification (Preferred, Standard)
Third-party risk management rating (Low, Medium, High)
Accounting period in YYYY-MM format (2025-01 to 2026-10)
ISO 4217 3-letter transaction currency code (GBP, USD, EUR)
Exchange rate multiplier to convert 1 unit of local currency into functional GBP
Treasury rate convention (Base Functional, Monthly Average)
Unique composite budget line identifier
Accounting month (YYYY-MM) linking to dim_fx_rates.csv and fact_gl_transactions.csv
Fiscal quarter label (Q1-2025 to Q4-2026)
Links to dim_cost_centers.csv
Links to dim_chart_of_accounts.csv
Board-approved annual operating plan (AOP) target in GBP
Updated rolling quarterly forecast (QRF) estimate in GBP
Unique ERP General Ledger journal line ID (JE-YYYY-NNNNNN)
Effective accounting posting date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Fiscal month (YYYY-MM)
Fiscal quarter (Q1-2025 to Q4-2026)
Departmental cost center (links to dim_cost_centers.csv)
Natural GL account (links to dim_chart_of_accounts.csv)
Supplier ID if entry originated from Accounts Payable (links to dim_vendors.csv; Null for payroll/revenue)
Originating ERP subledger (AR_BILLING_ENGINE, WORKDAY_PAYROLL, AP_VENDOR_INVOICE, etc.)
Original currency of transaction (GBP, USD, EUR)
Transaction amount in original local currency
Applied exchange rate to functional GBP
Consolidated reporting amount in GBP
SOX audit control flag indicating manual top-side journal entry (Yes/No)
Internal control workflow status (Approved, Pending Audit Review)
Unique Accounts Payable vendor invoice number (INV-000001)
Links directly to the corresponding GL expense posting in fact_gl_transactions.csv
Links to dim_vendors.csv
Links to dim_cost_centers.csv
Links to dim_chart_of_accounts.csv
Supplier invoice issue date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Contractual payment due date based on vendor terms
Actual cash disbursement date (Null if invoice is Open or Overdue)
Invoice net payment terms
Actual days elapsed from invoice_date to paid_date (used to compute DPO)
Invoice billing currency
Invoice gross amount in local currency
Invoice amount converted to functional GBP
Settlement lifecycle state (Paid, Open - Approved, Overdue)
